fetchNote: Direct fetches via the session proxy on 2026-11-08: sba.gov OK (200). BizBuySell, LoopNet, Crexi and CBRE returned HTTP 403 (bot protection) - not bypassed. FRED and GF Data would not connect. Everything not marked verified comes from search-result snippets of secondary sources.

sources.name: BizBuySell Q3 2026 Insight Report press release (via finviz)
sources.note: Search summary: 2,132 closed transactions in Q3 2026, flat vs Q2, -7% vs Q3 2025. Headline medians not seen.

sources.name: BizBuySell Insight Report (secondary write-ups: Q1/Q2 2026, FY2025)
sources.note: Via search snippets of third parties: avg cash-flow multiple 2.7 (Q1-Q2 2026), 2.61 FY2025 (2.57 FY2024); avg revenue multiple 0.7; Q2 2026 median sale price 349,250; sold at 94% of asking FY2025. Third-party, unverified.

sources.name: BigIdeasDB Main Street Index (27,500+ listings, asking multiples)
sources.note: Median asking 2.63x SDE, IQR 1.73-3.72x. Asking, not closed. Secondary.

sources.name: BizBen California index
sources.note: California median asking 300,000, 2.6x cash flow. Regional.

sources.name: BVR/BIZCOMPS Fall 2026 Deal Review (via bvresources)
sources.note: Construction highest median SDE multiple 2.14x; services highest revenue multiples.

sources.name: CT Acquisitions SDE multiples by industry
sources.note: Restaurants ~1.5x; HVAC and IT/MSP platforms 5x+. Broker marketing source.

sources.name: Iconic / other e-commerce & SaaS SDE multiple roundup (as summarised by search)
sources.note: Amazon FBA 2.8-4.2x, Shopify DTC 3.0-4.5x, small SaaS (<$1M ARR) 3.0-6.0x SDE.

sources.name: Mercer Capital Transactions Q2 2026 (citing GF Data)
sources.note: Approx 7x for $10-50M deals, 9-11x for $100-500M. Snippet truncated.

sources.name: CapitalPad lower-middle-market multiples
sources.note: Deals below $25M EV roughly 6x EBITDA. Source not named.

sources.name: NerdWallet SBA loan rates
sources.note: Prime 7% per this page; max variable rate Prime+3% (10%) for loans >$350K; 11.5% 250-350K; 13% 50-250K; 13.5% <=50K.

sources.name: SBA lender terms page (as quoted by search summary)
SOP 50 10 8 equity injection commentary (Whiteford, Starfield & Smith, Windsor Advantage)
sources.note: 10% minimum equity injection for change of ownership; seller note counts only if on full standby for loan life and <= 50% of required injection.

sources.name: BizBen broker fee article
sources.note: Broker commission 8-12% under $1M; Double Lehman 10% first $1M, dropping to 2% above $4M; min fee 10-15K; ~9 months on market assumption.

sources.name: Bankrate / Gerald / forecasts.org prime rate
sources.note: Prime 6.75% as of June 2026; conflicts with NerdWallet 7%. Unresolved.

sources.name: SBA.gov - 7(a) loans (fetched directly 2026-11-08)
sources.note: Primary source. Standard 7(a) max loan $5,000,000. NOTE: the 'maximum maturity 60 months' and tiered rate caps on that page belong to the 7(a) Working Capital Pilot, not standard 7(a); not used.

sources.name: SBA.gov - 504 loans (fetched directly 2026-11-08)
sources.note: Primary source. Max $5.5M; 10/20/25-year fixed terms; rate pegged to 10-year Treasury; fees ~3% of debt.

medianAskingPrice.note: BizBuySell Q3 2026 headline not retrieved. Median closed sale price 349,250 (Q2 2026); California median asking 300,000.

medianSDE.note: Not found. Implied roughly 130K from 349K price / 2.7x, a derived estimate only.

sizeBands.note: No size-band data retrieved. Market median ~2.6-2.7x; small deals generally at or below that.

ebitdaBySize.note: About 7x for $10-50M deals (GF Data via Mercer); below $25M EV about 6x (CapitalPad).

growth.note: No cited evidence found. Not estimated here; grader should treat any assumed ceiling as a judgment call, not a sourced benchmark.

sba7a.primeRateNote: Conflicting: 7.0 (NerdWallet, Sept 2026) vs 6.75 (Bankrate, June 2026). Current value unverified.

typicalRatePct.note: Max variable rate Prime+3% for loans >$350K (10% at Prime 7%); smaller loans cap at Prime+4.5% / +6.5% by size per NerdWallet. Typical actual range unverified.

sba7a.feeNote: Sources conflict (2-3.5% of guaranteed portion; FY2026 waivers). Not resolved.

sellerNote.standbyRule: Under SOP 50 10 8, seller note counts toward the 10% injection only on full standby for the loan life and capped at 50% of the injection (secondary sources).

sellBrokerPct.note: Under $1M; Double Lehman 10% on first $1M falling to 2% over $4M.

management.note: Not found. SDE adds back one owner's salary and perks; EBITDA after a market-rate manager salary is lower, so absentee ownership reduces cash flow by that replacement cost.
